products.name: ACET Official Crest & Institutional Seal Monolith
products.title: ACET Official Crest & Institutional Seal Monolith
products.description: Precision architectural crest of Akshaya College of Engineering & Technology. High-density resin monolithic block with 24K gold foil trim and debossed motto.
products.detailedStory: Engineered as an emblem of excellence for Akshaya students, faculty, and visiting dignitaries. Each piece is cured under calibrated 405nm UV chambers at our Kinathukadavu maker facility.
products.careInstructions: Clean with dry microfiber cloth. Keep out of direct sunlight exceeding 60°C.

products.name: 4:1 Planetary Reduction Gearbox (Print-in-Place)
products.title: 4:1 Planetary Reduction Gearbox (Print-in-Place)
products.description: Fully functional 4:1 epicyclic reduction gear assembly printed in a single pass without assembly. Demonstrates kinematic engineering mechanics with zero backlash.
products.detailedStory: Engineered and validated by student innovators of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE). Demonstrates precision mechanical tolerances for laboratory viva and robotics prototyping.
products.careInstructions: Use dry silicone lubricant for continuous high-speed rotation demonstration.

products.name: Computational Voronoi Adiyogi Shiva Monolith
products.title: Computational Voronoi Adiyogi Shiva Monolith
products.description: Algorithmic Voronoi mathematical tessellation sculpture of Lord Shiva. Cast from Carrara marble mineral composite with 50-micron SLA surface resolution.
products.detailedStory: Computational geometry generated via custom procedural Voronoi partitioning algorithms developed at the CSE 3D Lab. Finished with artisan mineral wash.
products.careInstructions: Wipe gently with damp soft cloth. Sealed with satin polyurethane finish.

products.name: Fibonacci Spiral Geodesic Ambient Desk Lamp
products.title: Fibonacci Spiral Geodesic Ambient Desk Lamp
products.description: Golden-ratio mathematical lattice lampshade with warm ambient LED diffuser base. Casts geometric shadow patterns engineered by CSE additive manufacturing team.
products.detailedStory: Derived from Fibonacci sequence spiraling phyllotaxis equations. Optimizes light diffusion while projecting geometric shadows.
products.careInstructions: Use only with included 5W low-heat LED USB light module.

products.name: Akshaya Techday & Symposium Champion Trophy
products.title: Akshaya Techday & Symposium Champion Trophy
products.description: Official Department of Computer Science and Engineering annual technical symposium trophy. Dual-tone metallic gold and satin emerald finish.
products.detailedStory: Commissioned for college symposia, hackathons, and academic honors. Features debossed college monogram and customizable winner plaque plate.
products.careInstructions: Handle with clean hands. Dust with soft feather brush.

products.name: CSE Department 3D Alumni Keepsake Pen Stand
products.title: CSE Department 3D Alumni Keepsake Pen Stand
products.description: Precision wireframe geometric desktop organizer featuring embossed Department of Computer Science and Engineering identity and smartphone docking cradle.
products.detailedStory: A tribute for graduating engineers and distinguished alumni of the CSE department. Practical, elegant, and permanently debossed.
products.careInstructions: Avoid immersion in water. Oil wood-fill PLA lightly once a year.

products.name: Additive Manufacturing Training Program Registration
products.description: 3-day In-house Student Training Program on Additive Manufacturing at CAMRI (9, 10 & 11 September 2026). Hands-on Training with Bambu Lab H2C, Multi-Material & Multi-Color Printing, Design to Print Workflow, Real-world Applications & Prototyping, Live Demonstrations & Practical Sessions. For In-house Students Only.
products.careInstructions: Bring your student ID card.

products.name: Articulated Flexi-Dragon
products.description: A fully articulated, print-in-place dragon with movable joints. Perfect for fidgeting or as a desk companion.
products.careInstructions: Keep away from excessive heat and direct sunlight to prevent warping.

products.name: Mythical Warrior Bust
products.description: A highly detailed fantasy warrior bust suitable for painting or display. Captures intricate armor and facial expressions.
products.careInstructions: Handle with care. Can be primed and painted with acrylics.

products.name: Geometric Spiral Planter
products.description: A modern, low-poly spiral vase perfect for small indoor plants or succulents. Printed with a watertight setting.
products.careInstructions: Indoor use only. Clean with a damp cloth.

products.name: Modular Desk Organizer
products.description: A customizable desk organizer set. Includes compartments for pens, a smartphone stand, and a tray for paperclips.
products.careInstructions: Wipe with a soft cloth. Do not use harsh chemicals.

products.name: Logic Gate Demonstration Model
products.description: A physical representation of basic logic gates (AND, OR, NOT) with snap-fit connectors for educational demonstrations in computer architecture classes.
products.careInstructions: Store in a cool, dry place. Snap-fit joints may loosen over time.

products.name: Scaled Robotic Arm Assembly
products.description: A functional, scaled-down mechanical robotic arm assembly. Ideal for CSE robotics labs and kinematic demonstrations.
products.careInstructions: Contains small moving parts. Assemble carefully.

products.name: Custom Nameplate Keychain
products.description: A personalized 3D-printed keychain with your name or custom text. Perfect as a quick gift or backpack tag.
products.careInstructions: Attach to keys securely. Avoid excessive bending.

products.name: Emoji Mascot Keychain
products.description: A small, fun mascot figurine keychain. Dual-color print featuring a classic emoji design.
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean if necessary.

products.name: Photo-to-3D Lithophane Bust
products.description: An example of our custom 3D modeling service. We convert a 2D photograph into a stunning 3D lithophane bust that illuminates when placed in front of light.
products.careInstructions: Keep out of direct sunlight. Place near a light source for best effect.

products.name: Custom Logo / Plaque Service
products.description: Example of our custom logo plaque printing. Provide your 2D logo, and we will extrude it into a professional, dual-color 3D sign.
products.careInstructions: Can be wall-mounted using double-sided tape.

products.name: Hackathon Champion Trophy
products.description: A themed trophy print designed for CSE department hackathons and coding fests. Features a geometric brain design.
products.careInstructions: Dust regularly. Fragile top sections.

products.name: Tech Fest Mascot Figurine
products.description: The official mascot of the annual department tech fest. A limited edition print available exclusively during event season.
products.careInstructions: Generic display item.

products.name: Lord Ganesh Idol
products.description: A traditional seated Ganesh figurine. Highly detailed, making it suitable for home or office altars and as a thoughtful gift. Resin printing is recommended to capture the finer details.
products.careInstructions: Handle with care. Dust with a soft brush.
products.title: Lord Ganesh Idol

products.name: Lord Shiva Idol
products.description: A finely detailed Shiva figurine depicted in a meditative pose. Ideal for display and gifting. For the best reproduction of intricate ornaments, select the Resin option.
products.careInstructions: Fragile details; avoid dropping.

products.name: Lord Krishna Idol
products.description: A beautifully sculpted Krishna figurine holding a flute. Perfect for festive gifting or home décor. We recommend the high-detail resin material for the best finish.
products.careInstructions: Keep away from direct heat.

products.name: Goddess Lakshmi Idol
products.description: A traditional Lakshmi figurine. A common festive and gifting item, printed with care. Choose the Resin material to ensure all fine jewelry details are perfectly resolved.
products.careInstructions: Dust with a soft brush.

products.name: Four-Bar Linkage Mechanism Demo Board
products.description: A working demonstration of a basic four-bar linkage mechanism. Hand-crank operated. Excellent teaching aid for engineering students exploring kinematics.
products.careInstructions: Do not force the crank. Lubricate joints lightly if squeaking occurs.

products.name: Gearbox / Gear Train Demonstration Model
products.description: A simple gear-train assembly demonstrating torque and speed relationships. Features multiple interchangeable gear ratios for educational exploration.
products.careInstructions: Keep fingers clear of meshing gears during operation.

products.name: Cam-and-Follower Mechanism Model
products.description: Demonstrates the conversion of rotary motion into linear motion via a cam profile. Perfect for hobbyists and mechanical engineering demonstrations.
products.careInstructions: Ensure the follower track remains clear of debris.

products.name: Miniature Engine Piston Assembly
products.description: A hand-crank-operated piston and cylinder demonstration model. Shows the internal reciprocating motion of a basic combustion engine block.
products.careInstructions: Tolerances are tight; handle gently to avoid binding.
